gpslogger.description:
GPSLogger is a free, open-source Android application designed to record location coordinates accurately and efficiently while minimizing battery consumption. It is useful for hiking, cycling, travel journaling, geotagging photographs, and collecting GPS tracks for personal mapping projects.

Record location points in the background at customizable time or distance intervals, with configurable accuracy filters and location providers. Export tracks to popular formats including GPX, KML, CSV, and NMEA, along with speed, direction, and altitude data when available.

GPSLogger supports multiple configuration profiles, automatic logging after device startup, notifications with quick controls, and integration with automation applications such as Tasker. Completed logs can be shared manually or sent automatically to services including OpenStreetMap, SFTP, Google Drive, Dropbox, email, or a custom server URL.

The application does not require an account for local recording. Network access is used for optional upload and sharing functions. Background location permission may be required for continuous tracking, and recording accuracy depends on device hardware, satellite reception, and Android power management.

GPSLogger is open-source software distributed under the GNU General Public License version 2.
